en.name: Standing side bends
en.subtitle: Follow along · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand facing the camera with your feet apart.
Make a small, comfortable bend to one side.
Come back to the middle, then try the other side.
en.focus: Follow your teacher and move at your own pace.

zh-Hant.name: 站立側彎
zh-Hant.subtitle: 跟著做 · 小一至小三
steps: 面向鏡頭站立，雙腳分開。
輕輕向一側彎一點，保持舒適。
zh-Hant.focus: 跟著老師，以自己的速度活動。
